PASS on the fake backend on the first gate run, exit 0; the digest above is the gate digest line the check printed. Served device mhs://localhost/mmk2-floor, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the catalogue floor of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). NO DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the family:mujoco decision and the MujocoDriver helper are used. The card's five entry_symbols were confirmed in the clone at the pinned commit (AIRBOTMMK2Env at policies/act/envs/airbot_com_mmk_env.py:10 and airbot_mmk_env.py:11, AIRBOTPlayWithCameraEnv at airbot_play_3_with_cam.py:11, airbot_play_4_with_cam.py:11 and airbot_play_5_with_cam.py:12); they are real-robot policy adapters and are not imported or run. The family serves the card's models[1], models/mjcf/mmk2_floor.xml, read in place from the read-only clone at d67f47c084aba0e0cf422a8725235f8b9238655a; the clone is unmodified. models[0], models/mjcf/leaphand_sensor_env.xml, is not used because its keyframe element at line 37 has no whitespace between the name and qpos attributes and a standard XML parser rejects it. The served scene includes mmk2_options.xml, mmk2_dependencies.xml, mmk2.xml and mmk2_control.xml: 28 qpos, 27 dof and 19 actuators. The bridge derives action.ctrl's per-actuator bounds from the model: wheel motors -35 to 35, lift -0.04 to 0.87 m, head yaw -0.5 to 0.5 rad, head pitch -1.18 to 0.16 rad, both arms from the Airbot Play joint classes, and both grippers 0 to 1; the package writes no Limit of its own. The fake backend is fake.py, a stand-in mujoco module that parses the same scene and integrates a placeholder first-order motion. driver.py names the FakeMujoco class object as the backend (the form the SDK's own MuJoCo tests use), so G2 skips its string-backends comparison and G7 reports UPSTREAM_BACKEND; the lock records the equivalent .fake:FakeMujoco entry. The gate's only warnings are the expected simulator-family ones: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (there is no package fake class surface for the family to record) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived ticks, action.ctrl and reset seed inputs. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine was not installed and was never run, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result; the stand-in computes no inertias, contacts, tendons, equalities or actuator and sensor dynamics and loads no meshes or textures; the model states no option timestep, the upstream MMK2Cfg sets 0.0025 s and SimulatorBase copies it onto the model, but this package loads the model file directly and the reference's timestep_ms 2.0 is the library default supplied by the stand-in's placeholder fallback, not a value stated by the model; cap.world.reset.v1 calls mj_resetData and does not apply the upstream init_state or the home keyframe; the upstream step runs four decimation substeps while a bridge tick is one mj_step; the upstream updateControl clips a control where the bridge refuses an out-of-range control; no rendering, cameras or the 19 joint sensors are published; snapshot/restore is advertised through the bridge but is not covered by the CL3 gate; no physical MMK2 is modelled or driven and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is the model, reviewed_by is null). No extension capability id was used, so there is no catalogue_requests entry.
